provenance.instrument: Millcreek Township Zoning Ordinance, Chapter 145 of the Millcreek Township Code (amended and restated by Ord. 2022-4), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code MI3114): includes legislation through 08-25-2026. New Laws lists Ord. 2026-10, Zoning Amendments, adopted 2026-09-22 and not yet codified. Its text was read. It changes R2 and R3 special exception lists (transitional dwelling), definitions and parking for other uses. It does not mention the In-Law Apartment.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 08-25-2026. Ord. 2026-10 (adopted 2026-09-22) is listed under New Laws.
checks: The In-Law Apartment is only for an in-law or a member of the family living in the main house. Rental to anyone else is prohibited (145-11, 145-58H)
It needs a special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board in CR, R1 and R2 only (145-14F, 145-15E, 145-16E)
It must be inside a single-family detached house. An addition must be architecturally integrated. No detached unit (145-58E, F)
The house must be owner-occupied. The owner's unit must be over 70% of the total living space (145-58B)
Size: 720 sq ft or 40% of the house total area including the garage, whichever is less. At most two bedrooms
An accessory structure may not be used for living space unless the chapter provides otherwise (145-27B)
The parking table has no In-Law Apartment row. A single-family detached house needs 2 spaces per dwelling unit. So 2 in total, or 4 if the apartment counts as a unit (145-92)
Size in practice: the owner's unit must be over 70% of living space, garage excluded. So the apartment is under 30% of living space. This usually binds before 720 sq ft or 40% of total area

Districts set a maximum density (CR 2.5, R1 4.25, R2 8.0, units not stated). The definition calls the apartment 'separate living space within a Single-Family Dwelling', so it likely does not count as a unit. Ask
For a second unit that is not for family: a duplex is a permitted use in CR and R2 (145-14B(2), 145-16B(1)). In R1 and R2 only one single-family house or duplex per lot (145-28A)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Zoning and Development Division, Planning and Development Department, https://millcreektownship.com/340/Zoning-Development-Division. Pending: Ord. 2026-10 adopted 2026-09-22, not yet in the online code. It does not touch 145-58. No pending ADU change found on the Zoning Code Update page.

term.note: 'A separate living space within a Single-Family Dwelling, Detached' for 'an in-law of, in-laws of or a member of the Family unit'

status.note: Family-only unit inside the house, by special exception in CR, R1 and R2.

value.name: Duplex dwelling (two units, not limited to family)
value.conditions: A permitted principal use in CR and R2. In R1 and R2 only one single-family detached dwelling or duplex per lot (145-28A). District lot and density rules apply.

path.note: 'The Zoning Hearing Board may approve a Use by Special Exception for the following Accessory Uses' including '(2) In-Law Apartment'. Same in CR (145-14F) and R2 (145-16E).

fallback_path.note: Reading: R3 and other districts do not list the In-Law Apartment. A use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board would be needed.

value.condition: The house must be owner-occupied and the owner's unit over 70% of the living space.
Only an in-law or a family member may live in the unit.

zoning_districts.note: Listed as an accessory use by special exception only in CR, R1 and R2. Not in R3 or other districts.

min_lot_sqft.note: No lot size rule for the In-Law Apartment. District lot sizes apply to the house.

existing_structure_only.note: 'Any addition or modification to the principal Dwelling to accommodate an In-Law Apartment shall be architecturally integrated'. Additions are allowed.

types_allowed.note: 'The In-Law Apartment may be located only within a primary Dwelling.' An addition is allowed. 'no Accessory Structure shall be used for living space' (145-27B).

max_sqft.note: 'shall not exceed 720 square feet or 40% of the principal Dwelling's total area, whichever is less'

max_share_of_house.note: The owner's unit must be 'greater than 70% of the total living space, including the In-Law Apartment', garage excluded. So the apartment is under 30% of living space. Also at most 40% of total area with garage, and 720 sq ft. The 30% rule usually binds.

max_share_internal.note: Same as max_share_of_house. The unit can only be inside the house. Strictly under 30% of living space.

max_sqft_internal.note: 'shall not exceed 720 square feet or 40% of the principal Dwelling's total area, whichever is less'

max_height_ft.note: The unit is inside the house, so the district building height applies (35 ft in CR, R1, R2). See districts.

setback_front_ft.note: Inside the house or an addition. District setbacks apply. See districts.

separation_ft.note: No detached unit, so no separation rule applies.

max_building_coverage.note: Varies by district: CR 25%, R1 32%, R2 32%. See districts.

max_impervious.note: The district tables set lot coverage only. No impervious limit was read.

occupancy.value: An in-law or a member of the family living in the main house. Rental to others is prohibited.

owner_occupancy.note: 'The Dwelling in which the In-Law Apartment is being created must be owner-occupied'

family_only.note: 'The occupancy or rental of an In-Law Apartment by persons other than in-laws as defined in this Chapter is expressly prohibited.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: Rental to anyone other than in-laws is prohibited. Reading: this bars short-term rental.

max_adus.note: 'Only one In-Law Apartment is allowed within any Single-Family Dwelling, Detached.'

sale_apart_allowed.note: Not addressed. The unit is inside the owner-occupied house.

reading.value: 2 in total, or 4 if the apartment counts as a dwelling unit. Table VII-1 has no In-Law Apartment row and sets 'Dwelling, Single-Family Detached 2 per dwelling unit'.

spaces_required.note: No In-Law Apartment row. 'Dwelling, Single-Family Detached 2 per dwelling unit'. Whether the apartment counts as a unit is not stated.

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage, defined as the area covered by principal and accessory buildings (145-11).

setback_front_ft.note: 25 ft facing a collector or higher street, 15 ft facing any other street.
